idea: Build a fitness & workout planner app

screens.purpose: Provides an immediate overview of daily physical readiness, today's auto-regulated workout session, muscle group recovery status, and workout streak performance.
screens.userGoal: Quickly assess physical recovery, view today's workout plan, and jump right into logging a workout.
exitActions: Tap 'Start Session' -> Open Active Workout Logger
Tap 'Edit Routine' -> Open Routine & Equipment Configurator
Tap 'View Detailed Progress' -> Open Progress & Analytics
screens.layoutStructure: Sticky top bar with user profile/streak + Scrollable body containing Readiness Gauge hero card, Today's Scheduled Workout card, Muscle Recovery Heatmap, and Quick Action bar + Persistent bottom tab navigation.
uiComponents: Today's Session Card with Start CTA

componentInteractions.action: Navigates directly to screen_active_workout initialized with today's dynamic plan
componentInteractions.feedback: Haptic click pulse and slide-left transition

componentInteractions.trigger: Tap on specific muscle region (e.g., Chest)
componentInteractions.action: Opens localized recovery modal detailing estimated fatigue %, hours resting, and recommended load modifier
componentInteractions.feedback: Subtle scale zoom on tapped muscle region with bottom sheet slide-up

screens.loadingState: Skeleton shimmer animation for readiness hero card, workout session preview, and heat map avatar outlines.
screens.emptyState: Rest day illustration with message 'Optimal Recovery Day. No workout required today!' and a 'Log Light Mobility' action button.
screens.errorState: Top warning banner 'Unable to calculate readiness score. Pull down to refresh health data.'
screens.successState: Green banner alert 'Health data synced successfully. Readiness updated to 88%!'
screens.mobileConsiderations: Thumb-accessible primary CTA pinned near lower half of screen; high visual contrast metrics visible in outdoor light or bright gym conditions.

screens.purpose: High-contrast, low-friction interface for real-time set tracking, rest timer orchestration, and auto-regulated weight/rep dynamic adjustments.
screens.userGoal: Effortlessly log sets, reps, and RPE during a workout while adhering to automated rest timing and load adjustments.
entryPoints: Tap 'Begin Routine' on Routine Builder Screen
exitActions: Tap 'Finish Session' -> Displays Workout Summary Modal -> Return to Dashboard Screen
Tap 'Quit Session' -> Confirmation dialog -> Return to Dashboard Screen
screens.layoutStructure: Top fixed bar (timer, workout progress bar, finish button) + Scrollable stack of exercise log cards with interactive set rows + Bottom fixed rest timer controller strip.
uiComponents: Set Row Matrix (Previous weight/reps, Target weight/reps, Actual Input, RPE selector, Checkbox)

componentInteractions.trigger: Single tap on completed set checkmark
componentInteractions.action: Logs set, locks row inputs, triggers rest timer countdown bar, and recalculates weight for next set if RPE deviates from target
componentInteractions.feedback: Vibrant green checkmark animation, sharp double-haptic vibration, and rest timer start audio pulse

componentInteractions.trigger: Single tap on suggestion tag (e.g., '+5 lbs suggested')
componentInteractions.action: Auto-populates next set weight input with AI suggested load based on previous RPE log
componentInteractions.feedback: Micro-pulse on target input field and subtle check mark indicator

screens.loadingState: Minimal translucent loading overlay with text 'Preparing dynamic session adjustments...'
screens.emptyState: Empty exercise log placeholder with prompt 'No exercises in this session. Tap + to add an exercise.'
screens.errorState: Inline notification badge 'Timer sound muted due to silent mode. Rest timer visible on screen.'
screens.successState: Full-screen celebration modal with confetti effect, total volume summary, and 'Workout Saved' badge.
screens.mobileConsiderations: Minimum touch targets increased to 56dp for fatigue tolerance; keep-screen-awake active during session; ultra-high contrast dark theme for gym visibility.

screens.purpose: Enables users to design custom workout splits, auto-generate AI routines, and filter exercises dynamically by available equipment.
screens.userGoal: Create or modify workout routines that align with target muscle groups and available gym equipment.
exitActions: Tap 'Save Routine' -> Save & return to Dashboard or Routines List
Tap 'Start This Routine' -> Open Active Workout Logger
screens.layoutStructure: Top sticky equipment filter pill carousel + Workout split tab strip (e.g., Day 1: Push, Day 2: Pull) + Reorderable exercise vertical list + Sticky bottom CTA bar.

componentInteractions.trigger: Single tap on equipment tag (e.g., 'Dumbbells Only')
componentInteractions.action: Filters available exercise library and flags incompatible exercises in current routine with a swap prompt
componentInteractions.feedback: Pill changes to active state color; non-matching exercises dim with alert badge

componentInteractions.action: Reorders exercise sequence within current workout day layout
componentInteractions.feedback: Card scales up slightly (1.02x), subtle shadow elevation drop, heavy continuous tactile haptic feedback

screens.loadingState: Grid skeleton pulses for exercise cards and loading spinner inside equipment filter list.
screens.emptyState: Illustration showing empty gym bag with text 'No routines match selected equipment filter. Adjust filters or generate with AI.'
screens.errorState: Alert dialog 'Unable to save routine offline changes. Retry when connected.'
screens.successState: Toast popup 'Routine Upper Body Hypertrophy updated and set as active routine!'
screens.mobileConsiderations: Smooth drag-and-drop gesture handles with clear tactile feedback; easily accessible pill tags optimized for horizontal thumb scrolling.

screens.purpose: Presents deep visual analytical feedback on long-term strength progression, calculated 1RM estimations, training volume, and muscle group symmetry.
screens.userGoal: Analyze personal records, spot strength imbalances, and verify progressive overload progress over time.
entryPoints: Tap 'View Detailed Progress' from Dashboard Screen
exitActions: Tap 'Export Data' -> Opens native share sheet
Tap exercise data point -> Opens detailed single-exercise history modal
screens.layoutStructure: Top filter controls (Timeframe & Metric switchers) + Vertical scrollable analytical card feed (1RM Trend Chart, Total Volume Stacked Bar, Muscle Balance Radar Chart, PR Milestone History).

componentInteractions.trigger: Single tap or drag on graph data point
componentInteractions.action: Displays precise date, logged weight, calculated 1RM, and session context tooltip
componentInteractions.feedback: Vertical chart guide-line snaps to nearest data node with light haptic click

componentInteractions.action: Re-aggregates and animates chart data for selected 3-month window
componentInteractions.feedback: Active tab indicator slides smoothly and graph line morphs to new coordinates

screens.loadingState: Animated chart path skeleton placeholders and pulse effects on summary metrics cards.
screens.emptyState: Card overlay with message 'Complete at least 3 workouts to reveal auto-calculated 1RM progression charts.'
screens.errorState: Inline error banner 'Failed to refresh chart data. Tap to reload.'
screens.successState: Gold badge overlay highlight 'New Personal Record Detected: Bench Press +10 lbs!'
screens.mobileConsiderations: Support landscape rotation for extended line chart analysis; pinch-to-zoom capabilities on dense timeline data.

navigationFlows.trigger: User opens app and taps 'Start Session' on Dashboard
User taps 'Edit Routine' on Dashboard or navigates to Routines tab
User taps 'View Detailed Progress' or Analytics bottom tab

globalRules: All primary interactive touch targets must measure at least 48x48dp, with active workout inputs reaching a minimum of 56x56dp for fatigue usability.
Screen dimming/sleep is explicitly disabled while screen_active_workout is in an active session state.
All workout session logging actions must support optimistic UI rendering and queue locally when network connectivity drops.
Provide immediate haptic and audible feedback for rest timer completion and set logging.
Auto-regulation algorithms must evaluate load and rep targets in under 100ms on device.

sharedComponents.name: Header Hero Card
sharedComponents.description: Standardized top hero container displaying primary focus score, summary badge, and dynamic accent borders.

sharedComponents.name: Rest Timer Bar Widget
sharedComponents.description: Persistent dynamic progress bar counting down rest duration with quick +30s and skip controls.

sharedComponents.name: Equipment Filter Pill Group
sharedComponents.description: Horizontal scroll container of selectable filter pills for equipment availability.

sharedComponents.name: Metric Stat Chip
sharedComponents.description: Compact visual tag displaying target metric values (Weight, Reps, RPE, Fatigue) with status color overlays.

designRequirementsForStitch.typographyGuidelines: High-impact condensed bold sans-serif font (e.g., Teko/Saira) for metric callouts and timers. Clean geometric sans-serif (Inter/Roboto) for body labels. Numeric display: 48pt bold mono; H1 Headings: 28pt bold; H2 Headings: 22pt semi-bold; Body: 16pt regular; Labels/Captions: 12pt medium.
designRequirementsForStitch.spacingAndGrid: Strict 8pt baseline grid token system using standard increments: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64px.
componentVariantsNeeded: Primary Action CTA Button (Default, Active Pressed, Disabled, Success State, High-Contrast Glow)
Set Matrix Input Row (Unfilled Default, Active Focus, Auto-Regulated Suggestion, Completed Checked, Error Alert)
Metric Stat Pill (Inactive Dark, Active Neon, Rested Cyan, Alert Red)
Interactive Chart Canvas (Default Light Line, Node Selected, Empty Data State)
motionAndMicroInteractions: Rest timer countdown shrink bar with 60fps linear transition
Set row completion checkmark tactile spring animation (150ms tension bounce)
Chart line dynamic morphing upon timeframe tab tap (300ms ease-in-out)
0.95x subtle scale-press response on all main gym CTA buttons
